name: ph-electricity-rates
title: Philippine electricity rates per distribution utility (prototype)
description: DOE's hand-compiled monthly rate sheet as a tidy, joinable dataset, with a master list of distribution utilities keyed by a stable ID and PSGC codes, and automated checks against utilities' own rate documents.

licenses.name: ODC-BY-1.0
licenses.title: Open Data Commons Attribution License (compilation); source data remains under its publishers' terms

sources.title: DOE: Electricity rates per distribution utility (Google Sheet)
Wikipedia: List of electric distribution utilities in the Philippines

resources.name: utilities
resources.description: Master list v0: one row per distribution utility in DOE's rate sheet, with PSGC coverage.

fields.name: utility_id
fields.description: Stable slug ID, issued once from DOE's printed name and never reissued.

fields.name: doe_name
fields.description: Utility name exactly as DOE prints it (usually the acronym).

fields.name: name
fields.description: Full name, from the coverage source.

fields.name: psgc_province_codes
fields.description: Semicolon-separated 10-digit PSGC province codes of the franchise area. Empty if unsupported by the source.

fields.name: psgc_independent_city_codes
fields.description: PSGC codes of served cities that belong to no province (highly urbanised and independent component cities, all of NCR).

resources.name: rates
resources.description: Monthly retail rate per customer class and blended generation charge, PHP/kWh, as DOE compiled them.

fields.name: utility_id
fields.description: Stable slug ID, issued once from DOE's printed name and never reissued.

fields.name: month
fields.description: YYYY-MM.

fields.name: rate_php_per_kwh
fields.description: Retail rate in PHP/kWh. Null where DOE has no data (see rate_note).

fields.name: generation_charge
fields.description: Blended generation charge in PHP/kWh for the utility-month (same on every class row).

fields.name: rate_note
fields.description: Empty for a clean number; NDA (DOE: no data available), blank, or unparsed:<cell>.
